title: Independence Day script came from the CIA
summary: Steven Greer tells of Independence Day script came from the CIA, about 1996 at Hollywood, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: that whole script was like out of CIA central scripting casting.

plain: A researcher and disclosure campaigner named Steven Greer says on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2025 that the script of Independence Day, the 1996 Hollywood alien film starring Will Smith, came straight out of the CIA, the US spy agency. In his words, it was like the work of the agency's own scripting and casting department. If true, it would mean the government shapes how the public pictures aliens.
